pokedexEntries.di: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

pokedexEntries.prl: When endangered, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.

pokedexEntries.pt: It releases various pheromones to make the grubs in its body do its bidding while fighting foes.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control COMBEE.

pokedexEntries.sw: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

pokedexEntries.sh: Vespiquen that give off more pheromones have larger swarms of Combee attendants.

pokedexEntries.shp: When it is in danger, grubs from its six-cell honeycomb strike back. There is only one in a colony.

pokedexEntries.la: Commands its subjects to build its hive. It will dispatch any interlopers who dare sneak into its nest and use them as nourishment for itself.
